proposal.name: task_spec_to_plan_alignment
proposal.trigger: At plan_task, and again at revise_plan, for any task whose plan is assembled from a component catalogue that carries default selections and default parameter values - apply before the step list is finalised.
proposal.objective: Guarantee that every requirement clause in the task objective is implemented by a named component and an explicit parameter choice, and that no catalogue default survives unexamined, so the plan encodes the task's own definitions (populations and denominators, date keys, amount columns, statistics, breakdowns, caveats, artifacts) rather than the catalogue's conveniences.
procedure: Split the task objective into atomic requirement clauses: one per metric, per population or denominator definition, per named date event, per amount column, per statistic level, per breakdown, per caveat or communication rule, and per required artifact.

For each clause, name the component that satisfies it and the exact parameter value(s) it needs, and write that mapping into the plan rationale. A clause with no component is a gap: look first among components with default_selected=false and add the matching one explicitly; only then conclude the catalogue cannot express it and say so.

Walk the catalogue in the opposite direction: for every component and every parameter, compare its default with the mapped requirement. Override each default that diverges (denominator or population option, date column, amount columns, statistics level, breakdown columns, figure flags). Retain a default only when a task clause or an analytical standard positively supports it - the test is divergence from the task, not the default itself.

Cross-check required artifacts: each artifact the task lists must appear in the artifacts of some selected component, and the parameters that gate its production (for example a figure flag) must be set so it is actually emitted.

Set communication parameters last and deliberately: every rate printed as numerator / denominator = rate, every results bullet cited to an artifact or metrics key, and a non-empty caveat list matched to the task type (synthetic data on every task; descriptive-only for non-modelling tasks; class imbalance, model limitations and no-operational-use where a model or the fraud label is involved).

Verify against the manifest summary that every column the plan relies on exists, that its dtype suits the use (string dates must be parsed and the unparseable count reported), and that its null count does not undermine the choice; prefer an alternative column when it does.
Record in the plan rationale each default that was overridden and why, and each non-default component that was added and why, so a reviewer can trace every plan choice back to a task clause.
required_checks: Every requirement clause in the objective maps to a component and parameter value; no clause is left unmapped or silently dropped.
Every parameter that differs from its default is justified by a task clause or analytical standard, and every retained default has been positively confirmed against the task text.
Every required artifact is produced by a selected component with the gating parameters set.
Every component the task needs that is default_selected=false has been added explicitly to the step list.

Denominator options match the task's population wording (resolved units only when the outcome exists only for resolved units; all units when the task says whole portfolio), and date keys match the event the task names.
Report parameters show denominators and citations, and the caveat list is non-empty and includes the synthetic-data caveat.
Every column referenced by a chosen parameter exists in the manifest with a compatible dtype.
expected_artifacts: Plan rationale containing the clause-to-component mapping, the list of overridden defaults with reasons, and the list of added non-default components with reasons.
metrics.json entries for each mapped rate carrying numerator, denominator and both definitions, so the mapping is verifiable downstream.
failure_modes: Reading default_selected=false as 'not needed' and omitting a component the objective explicitly asks for.
Using the default all-units denominator when the outcome is only defined for resolved units, or restricting the denominator when the task says across the whole portfolio.
Keying a time series on the default date column instead of the event the task names, shifting period counts by the lag between the two dates.
Reporting sum and mean only for right-skewed dollar fields when the task asks for distribution quantiles, or summarising a single amount column when several are named.
Leaving caveats empty or denominators and citations switched off because those are the catalogue defaults.
Justifying the plan as a list of components rather than as a clause-by-clause mapping, so gaps and divergent defaults go unnoticed.
Overriding defaults reflexively: changing a default that already matches the task adds noise and obscures the genuine overrides.
proposal.example: Provenance: task T2 (run_001, attempt 1), reflection lesson on catalogue defaults; the task passed with no failed checks and no evaluator feedback, so there are no source feedback ids. Applying the procedure there: 'status mix' -> claim_volume by=[claim_status] with figure=true; 'denial rate among claims whose adjudication has concluded' -> denial_rate denominator=adjudicated_claims (default all_claims diverged); 'fraud-label prevalence across the whole portfolio' -> fraud_prevalence added (default_selected=false) with denominator=all_claims; 'billed, allowed and paid with totals, means and quantiles' -> financial_summary amount_columns=[billed_amount, allowed_amount, paid_amount], statistics=sum_mean_quantiles (default was paid_amount only, sum_mean); 'month in which the service began' -> monthly_trend date_column=service_date_from (default adjudication_date); 'every rate shows its denominator, synthetic and descriptive' -> write_report show_denominators=true, cite_artifacts=true, caveats=[synthetic_data, descriptive_only] (defaults false, false, empty). Six defaults were overridden and one non-default component added, each recorded in the rationale.
